prompt:
summarize_by_extension in storage_report.py is done and the one test passes. The spec is in README.md. Harden this before I submit: write the edge case tests the graders would probably run.

Input files: README.md, pyproject.toml, storage_report.py, tests/test_storage_report.py
assertions: New tests are written for pytest under the tests folder, and at least one test uses pytest.mark.parametrize; no unittest.TestCase class or new test dependency is introduced

The tests include extensions that differ only in case (for example "a.JPG" and "b.jpg") expecting one lowercase group, and two extensions with equal totals expecting them ordered by extension ascending
The final response reports that summarize_by_extension does not merge mixed-case extensions as a bug in storage_report.py, and storage_report.py is not modified during the run
A test asserts that a negative size raises ValueError using pytest.raises

The response contains an edge-case table in which every row has an input, an expected result, a reason naming the bug that row would catch, and a source marking it as stated in README.md or assumed, and every row marked as from the README matches what README.md actually says
